contract.title: SOC Dashboard Visual Parity - Rework 15
acceptance_criteria: Only Rework 15 is executable and only the exact six allowed paths may change; all other product, test, backend, provider, routing and runtime paths remain unchanged.

Change only the WorkspaceId.EXECUTIVE display name in the central workspaceRegistry from Executive to CISO / ISO while preserving WorkspaceId.EXECUTIVE, /executive, workspaceRoutes, WorkspaceOutlet resolution and component identity.
workspaceRegistry remains the single display-name authority consumed by the closed WorkspaceSwitcher and Sidebar current-workspace label; introduce no second display-name map.

Render exactly three ordered semantic menu groups: SOC WORKSPACES containing SOC Analyst, Threat Hunter, Threat Intelligence and Incident Response; MANAGEMENT WORKSPACES containing CISO / ISO and Risk Manager; SYSTEM / ADMINISTRATION containing Administrator.
Define group membership through explicit ordered canonical WorkspaceId lists and never infer it from display names, order, descriptions or routes.
Administrator occurs only in SYSTEM / ADMINISTRATION and never in SOC or Management; every enabled workspace occurs exactly once.
Group labels are visually subordinate to workspace entries and visible dividers separate SOC, Management and Administration within the existing menu surface.
The selected entry retains Purple styling and aria-current and gains a visible checkmark or equivalent indicator that is not the sole selected-state signal.
The existing bounded 11px Switcher control retains visible background, border, padding, Chevron, pointer, hover and focus-visible states; do not redesign the broader Topbar.
Selecting CISO / ISO uses the canonical Executive ID and navigates to /executive; selecting SOC Analyst returns to / through the existing setWorkspace and navigate boundary.

The real WorkspaceOutlet regression renders real SOC Dashboard and real Executive workspace composition for / to /executive to / and verifies route, Sidebar identity and closed Switcher identity without Browser Back, reload or manual URL input.

Visible WorkspaceSwitcher persona text no longer uses Executive; existing content terms including Executive Briefing, Executive Summary and internal type, file and component names remain outside this bounded product-label change.
WorkspaceOutlet.tsx, workspace IDs, routes, workspace navigation definitions, page content, Sidebar layout and all Rework 10 through 14 product behavior remain unchanged and passing.
Focused WorkspaceSwitcher and Topbar tests, the real cross-workspace integration test and existing Sidebar, PlatformLayout, SOC, Explainability and Executive regressions pass.
The full frontend regression, TypeScript, production build and git diff --check pass and Scope Guard confirms only the exact six authorized paths changed.
The immutable visual reference remains unchanged with SHA-256 af672a97050c5e535199d8d006012cf000e5e7b9b66693a02817c4356eea80df.

Product Owner Live Acceptance remains mandatory at 1536 x 1024 and 100 percent zoom for the closed control, all three open groups, / to /executive to /, Back and Forward and the Rework 14 Sidebar/Main geometry.
Do not claim Product Owner PASS, transition TASK-0122 to DONE or create TASK-0123.
